title: Rank jumps for Jacobians of Hyperelliptic curves on K3 surfaces
summary: We study Mordell-Weil rank jumps on families of jacobians of a pencil of genus-2 curves on a K3 surface defined over a number field k. We exhibit a finite extension l/k over which the subset of fibers for which the rank jumps is infinite. Moreover, we describe further geometric conditions on the K3 surface under which the rank jumps on a non-thin set of fibers.
